The most common win left on "LADY LUCK" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $1,000, and seven of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "LADY LUCK" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
990.headline: What the prize table shows

992.body:
"$2 MILLION VAULT" is in the second half of its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

The numbers for "$2 MILLION VAULT" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
992.headline: How far along this game is

993.body:
"$5,000 Triple Play" has gone four months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About three-quarters of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $5,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Today's free summary of "$5,000 Triple Play" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
993.headline: No top prize claimed lately

994.body:
"$25,000 Triple Play" has one of four top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Tomorrow's count on "$25,000 Triple Play" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
